
{{alias}}( x[, options] )
    Computes the softmax function for each element in an input array.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ArrayLikeObject
        Input array.

    options: Object (optional)
        Function options.

    options.dtype: string (optional)
        Output array data type.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array|TypedArray
        Output array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 ] )
    [ ~0.090, ~0.245, ~0.665 ]


{{alias}}.assign( x, out )
    Computes the softmax function for each element in an input array and assigns
    results to a provided output array.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ArrayLikeObject
        Input array.

    out: Array|TypedArray|Object
        Output array.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array|TypedArray|Object
        Output array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias:@stdlib/array/zeros}}( 3, 'float64' );
    > var v = {{alias}}.assign( [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 ], out )
    <Float64Array>[ ~0.090, ~0.245, ~0.665 ]
    > var bool = ( out === v )
    true

    See Also
    --------
